back: Creations of the mind (inventions, brands, designs, creative work) that the law allows owners to protect.
Patents, trademarks, copyright, industrial designs, geographical indications.
Patent: protects an invention; must be registered; limited time. Copyright: protects creative work; automatic.
Copying and selling copyright work (music, films, software) without permission.
Making fake goods that copy another business's brand or trademark.
African Regional Intellectual Property Organization, HQ Harare: one application for protection in several member states.
World Intellectual Property Organization, a UN agency in Geneva: promotes IP protection, administers treaties, helps developing countries.
Damages, injunction, seizure and destruction of goods, fines or imprisonment, account of profits.
A payment to the owner of intellectual property for each use or sale under a licence.
